paragraphs: Good morning, everyone! This is our weather report for the week. I am Lily, and this is Tom. Tom shows the clothes for every day. The whole class watches us on the TV. On Monday, the weather is sunny and hot. There is a big sun in the sky. Tom wears a hat and shorts. "Is it always hot?" asks Tom. "No," says Lily. "Look at Tuesday!"

On Tuesday, there is rain. The ground is wet. The rain is loud on the roof. Tom wears a coat and boots. On Wednesday, it is cloudy. There are gray clouds, but there is no rain. It is a little cold, so Tom wears a sweater. On Thursday, it is windy. The wind is strong! "Hold your hat!" says Tom. Lily laughs. The children in the class clap.

On Friday morning, there is rain again. In the afternoon, the sun comes out. "Look!" says Lily. "I can see a rainbow!" It has red, orange, yellow, green, and blue. What is the weather today, class? Is it sunny, cloudy, or windy? Look out of the window. Tom smiles and takes off his coat. Tom says, "I like all weather, with the right clothes!"
